_notes.https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mXQHehv: Cervino S.p.A.'s official tariff file, linked from cervinia.it/skirama. Confirmed title: 'TARIFFE INVERNO 2026-27.pdf'. Contents not readable from this environment - Drive is outside the network allow-list.
DEAD - the old shop host does not answer. cervinia.it now sends its shop button to shop.cervinoskiparadise.it instead.
_notes.https://torinoebraica.it/en/jewish-life/: Turin community's own English page - the authoritative list of what is under the Turin Rabbinical Office, and it links their 2026 certified-product list, so it is maintained.
_notes.https://torinoebraica.it/wp-content/uplo: ARI (Assembly of Italian Rabbis) approved-product list, 5786/2026, 92pp, Italian. Reissued annually - the URL needs a yearly refresh. Text extraction stops at p.46, so the chocolate/coffee/tea/biscuit pages are not machine-readable from here.
_notes.https://www.comunitaebraicabologna.it/en: The Bologna community's searchable version of that same ARI list: 1,471 products, search by brand, category browse, and barcode scan with the phone camera. Confirmed via the community's own announcement page.

https://www.cervinia.it/en/impianti: Cervino S.p.A.'s own live lift-and-piste status page, with separate tabs per sector: Breuil-Cervinia, Valtournenche, Chamois, Torgnon, Zermatt. Updated after 08:30. Opened 19-10-2026 (out of season: shows 0 lifts / 0 slopes).
https://balteus.lovevda.it/it/banca-dati: Forte di Bard. Confirmed: Tue-Sun only (no Monday in the regular schedule), open every day 26 Dec - 6 Jan, extraordinary Monday 7 Dec, tickets 15/12 and All Forte 24 EUR.

Museo delle Alpi. Carries the refurbishment notice verbatim: 'chiuso per lavori di riallestimento dal 13 ottobre al 22 novembre 2026'. RE-CHECK after 22-11-2026 and delete the warning from texts.json.
Castello Gamba, Chatillon. Confirmed Oct-Mar 10:00-17:00 Tue-Sun, closed Mondays except Jul/Aug and holidays, 6/4/3 EUR, under 18 free, park free all year.
https://balteus.lovevda.it/en/database/8: Museo delle Guide Alpine del Cervino. Confirmed: Via Circonvallazione 2, VALTOURNENCHE; every day 09:00-12:00 / 14:00-17:30; free entrance. Note the page files it under the Breuil-Cervinia resort while the postal address is Valtournenche - the labelling really is inconsistent.
https://balteus.lovevda.it/it/banca-dati: MegaMuseo / Area megalitica, Aosta. Confirmed Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00 (Monday absent), family guided 25 EUR, and the 'Aosta archeologica' combined ticket at 10 EUR for five sites valid six months.

Criptoportico forense, Aosta. Confirmed open every day Oct-Mar 10:00-13:00 / 14:00-17:00, closed only 25 Dec and 1 Jan - i.e. no weekly closing day, which is the whole point of the 'stormy Monday, go to Aosta' rule.
Castello di Fenis. Confirmed closed Mondays except Jul/Aug and holidays, winter 10:00-13:00 / 14:00-17:00, 10/7 EUR, under 18 free.
Castello di Saint-Pierre + Museo Regionale di Scienze Naturali. Confirmed Oct-Mar 10:00-18:00 Tue-Sun, closed Mondays, family guided 30 EUR, and the lift is switched off when there is snow.
https://balteus.lovevda.it/en/database/5: Funivia Buisson-Chamois. Confirmed 07:00-22:30, every 30 min (extra quarter-hour runs when 15+ wait), all year bar short maintenance, ~800 m of climb. Use the balteus mirror - www.lovevda.it is robots-disallowed.
Skyway Monte Bianco. Confirmed station altitudes Pontal d'Entreves 1,300 m, Pavillon du Mont Frety 2,200 m, Punta Helbronner 3,466 m. NO maintenance-closure dates on this page - do not publish any.
https://balteus.lovevda.it/it/banca-dati: Sauna / idromassaggio / bagno turco at the Valtournenche sports centre. Confirmed 16 EUR single entry and 'nel prezzo della sauna e dell'idromassaggio e incluso anche l'utilizzo della piscina'. Hours genuinely contradict themselves on the page (14-19 vs winter 13-20) - that is why the site says to phone.
Centro sportivo polifunzionale comunale, Piazza Carrel 5, Valtournenche. Lists piscina/sauna/bagno turco/idromassaggio but gives NO price - the 16 EUR figure lives on record 2565, not here.
https://www.qcterme.com/destinations/pre: QC Spa Pre Saint Didier, admissions and prices. Carries the age rule verbatim: 'Pregnant women and children under the age of 14 are not permitted to enter the wellness centre.' Lowest entry shown 44 EUR (Spa Under the Star, from 19:30). The main destination page does NOT state the age limit - link this one.
https://laviadelleterme.it/terme-di-sain: Terme di Saint-Vincent (operator site, La Via Delle Terme). Confirmed 'I bambini entrano dai 10 anni di eta' and the 39 EUR evening ticket (last 3 hours, Mon-Sun, kit excluded). Booking stated as obligatory on the children's rates.
https://www.casinodelavallee.com/en/: Casino de la Valle, Saint-Vincent. Confirmed entrance always free, 18+ only, valid ID required for an entrance ticket, open from 10:00 seven days a week.
https://cervinia.it/en/cosa-fare/34684-2: Winter Park Torgnon, Chantorne bowl at the top of the village cable car. Confirmed tubing, snakegliss, zibob, sledging, children's area; entrance 13 EUR; certified helmet mandatory. Header showed 'Closed' out of season.
https://cervinia.it/en/cosa-fare/pattina: Ice rink, Piazza Frutaz, Torgnon. Confirmed 7 Dec - 15 Jan with possible extension, 10 EUR full / 8 residents / minors 5 EUR with two paying adults.
https://www.decathlon.it/store-view/nego: Decathlon Aosta, actually at Quart. Confirmed Strada Statale 26 n.71, loc. Amerique, 11020 Quart (AO); Sunday 09:00-20:00; CLOSED 25 and 26 December 2026.
https://www.carrefour.it/punti-vendita/c: Carrefour Iper, L'Ile-des-Lapins 22, Pollein. Confirmed Monday to Sunday 07:30-21:00, Sunday included.
https://www.torinooutletvillage.com/it/l: Torino Outlet Village, Settimo Torinese. Confirmed 'Siamo aperti tutti i giorni, dalle 10.00 alle 20.00' and the address Via Torino 160-162. The site ROOT renders its brand list as 'Nessun risultato trovato' - link this page, not the root.
https://www.comune.aosta.it/it/page/merc: Comune di Aosta, official markets page. Confirmed the city market on TUESDAY over five streets and on SATURDAY over three, the covered market Mon-Sat, and small neighbourhood markets Mon/Wed/Thu/Fri. The page gives no stall counts - do not publish those as official.
https://balteus.lovevda.it/en/database/5: Natural ice rink, Breuil-Cervinia. The regional database itself titles it 'The Glow Village' and gives theglowvillage.it, so the brand is current, not invented. Skate and deckchair rental on site, 11:00-00:00, normally Nov-Mar (the record's own date field says 01/11-01/05).
https://cervinia.it/en/cosa-fare/sleddog: Cervino Ski Paradise's own sleddog page. Confirms the operator Siberiana Husky Sleddog, ~55 min (15 briefing + 40 ride), children 9+ up to 40 kg drive their own sled with 2 dogs, 3-8 ride in the instructor's bag, +39 320 887 6002.
https://balteus.lovevda.it/en/database/5: Cross-country loop at the entrance to Breuil-Cervinia. Confirms 2 km easy, 2,050 m, by the large car park, 10:00-16:00, day ticket 7 EUR.
https://cervinia.it/en/cosa-fare/ciaspol: Official snowshoe routes page for Breuil-Cervinia. Confirms the Lago di Loz loop at 3.7 km / 227 m, starting from Losanche or the gondola car park.
https://mapy.com/en/zimni?source=osm&id=: 20-10-2026: 25 piste deep links resolved against Mapy itself in a browser and each one opened to confirm it lands on the run. Mapy's id is its own, not an OSM way id - way 1002634775 in OSM is a building in Bangladesh. Regenerate by searching the exact OSM name on mapy.com and reading the id the page settles on; see research/pistes_official.md.
_notes_swiss: 20-10-2026: both opened in a browser. The lift-status page really does carry the fields 'Last connection Zermatt' and 'Last connection Cervinia' - that is why the app links to it rather than only printing a fixed time. The PDF is the official Zermatt Bergbahnen winter 2026/27 timetable and is the source for 14:50 / 15:20; it is reissued every season, so re-check the link and the times each autumn.
_notes_tariff: 20-10-2026: the official Cervino S.p.A. winter 2026/27 tariff. It is NOT a PDF on cervinia.it - the site links it as a Google Drive file, which is why repeated searches for a TARIFFE-INVERNO-2026-27.pdf under cervinia-api.therocks.it came back empty. Reach it from cervinia.it, menu item Tarifs; note the top-level Tarifs link currently points at the SUMMER sheet and the winter one is the second link on that page.
https://lovecervinia.com/: Love Cervinia, apres-ski. Operator site, read 22/10/2026: 'Loc. Plantorrette (2450 mt.) 11021 Breuil-Cervinia', hours 8.30-16.45, apres-ski 14.00-16.45, open 7 days in winter, tel 3458002544 / 3349062714. Arrival described exactly as ours: gondola to Plan Maison then piste 5, or Cretaz chair from piste 3.
https://lovesuperg.com/en/cervinia/: Super G Cervinia. Operator site, read 22/10/2026: 'At 2,450 metres' (our 2,500 was wrong - corrected), 'Localita Plan Torrette - Seggiovia Pancheron', '*Only for skiers', tel +39 0166 360000.
https://www.yeticervinia.it/HomeEN: Yeti Bar. Operator site, read 22/10/2026: 'Via Bich, 10 - Condominio Pic Tyndall 11028 VALTOURNENCHE', 'begins in 1984', 'In 1993 the place received the coveted recognition of Beer Academy', 'Nine Plugs and 25/30 brands in bottle'. Tel 0166949196 / 3337851758.
https://www.locopapan.it/en/contacts: Lo Copa Pan. Operator site, read 22/10/2026: 'Via Carrel, 47 Breuil Cervinia', tel +39 0166 949140 / +39 0166 940084. The second number matches the lovevda contact index entry 'Restaurante Copa Pan: 0166940084'.
https://www.ymeletrob.it/en/: Ymeletrob. Operator site, read 22/10/2026: 'Piazza Guide Maquignaz 4, 11021 Breuil Cervinia', 'local artist Marie Ange Maquignaz's animal and mountain paintings', restaurant 12.00-14.30 and 18.45-22.30, cocktail bar 15.30-midnight. Tel +39 3762058304 (also WhatsApp).
https://www.igloocervinia.com/: Igloo. Operator site, read 22/10/2026: 'Pista n.7 Ventina, Breuil-Cervinia', '+39 389 194 3622', '10:00 - 17:00 (possibili variazioni in base alle condizioni meteo)', banner says Open. Google Maps shows 'temporarily closed' - that is the off-season flag, not a closure.
https://www.oraridiapertura24.it/filiale: Second source for the Ventina self-service phone, which the regional database does not expose: '338.6642596', 'Cond. Giomein snc, 11021 Breuil-Cervinia (AO)'. Agrees with the number already on our site.
https://www.isprambiente.gov.it/it/attiv: Museo delle Guide del Cervino: 'Via Circonvallazione 2', 11021 Valtournenche, tel '0166 948169', info@guidedelcervino.com, 'Aperto tutti i giorni 9.30-18.00'. NOTE: the regional database gives 9.00-12.00 / 14.00-17.30 instead - the two sources disagree, so the site shows both and says to phone.
https://bazg.admin.ch/bazg/en/home/infor: Swiss side of the customs line: CHF 150, 'can be claimed only once per person and per day', and 'If the total value exceeds CHF 150, you must pay VAT on the total value of the imported goods' - which is exactly the all-or-nothing rule we bold.
https://www.adm.gov.it/portale/documents: Italian side: Agenzia Dogane e Monopoli 'Carta del viaggiatore'. '300 EUR per viaggiatore', '430 EUR nel caso di arrivo in aereo e via mare', 150 EUR for under-15s 'indipendentemente dal mezzo di trasporto utilizzato', cash declaration from 10.000 EUR.
https://lovevda.it/es/busquedas/servicio: Regional services listing for Breuil-Cervinia, read 22/10/2026. Enumerates SEVEN car parks: 'Baselli Parking', 'Blue Lake parking', 'Breithorn Parking', 'Cervino Lift Parking', 'Chateau Parking', 'Circonvallazione Parking', 'Tunnel Parking'. Our site carries five - Tunnel ('lato galleria') was dropped as not useful, and Blue Lake sits out on regional road 46 below the village. No 'Plan Maison' car park exists. Comune phones confirmed as 016692032 / 0166946811; the lift car park is 0166944311.
https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/co: Italy vs Switzerland drink prices, read 22/10/2026. 'Cappuccino (Regular Size)' 1.77 vs 5.47 EUR, 'Domestic Draft Beer (0.5 Liter)' 5.00 vs 8.10, 'Imported Beer (0.33 Liter Bottle)' 5.00 vs 6.48, 'Soft Drink (Coca-Cola or Pepsi, 0.33 Liter Bottle)' 2.71 vs 4.77, 'Bottled Water (0.33 Liter)' 1.23 vs 4.34. Page states 'Last update: 22 October 2026' / '21 October 2026' and 'Contributors in the past 12 months: 1721' / '708'. CROWD-SOURCED and TOWN-level: no mountain hut on either side publishes a drinks list, checked again on 22/10/2026 (igloocervinia.com shows its menu as photos, chezvrony.ch publishes no prices).
